text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Isn't because I'm stronger. It's<n>because I wholly
believed in my<n>possibilities.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And that's something everyone can<n>do! I was born
to show the world that,<n>and I won to prove the
power of<n>possibility!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
After the race, Taiki asks me to race<n>her again, but I
turn her down<n>because there's something Trainer
and I need to do...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's right! I'm going to run in a<n>European G1! I'll
be going all over<n>the world to meet more of the
Pearl<n>family next year!
